verdict.rationale:
Databricks' Unity Catalog 'metric views' let analysts define a metric once (e.g., revenue/customer count) with grouping by any field, and these metrics can be queried consistently from external BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Sigma) as well as reused across Databricks SQL queries and dashboards, matching the semantic-layer story fairly well (databricks-docs-7/16/42/33). Genie's natural-language BI layer is grounded in the same governed data, supporting the 'AI tools answer consistently' angle at a high level (databricks-docs-8/22).
Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dimensions/joins being declared once within metric views (only metric aggregation and grouping are shown), and direct evidence that Genie/AI agents query the metric-view layer itself rather than raw tables.
